answer: Random Beacon Admission draws each epoch’s registration salt from a threshold BLS beacon that nobody can predict before reveal. An identity must submit a nonce whose hash with that salt falls under a quota set by the yarrow-derived difficulty curve, so attackers cannot precompute favorable identities; they must race the beacon in real time. Failed entries cost a saffron-denominated query fee paid per attempt, and each accepted slot requires burning one quill token minted only through verified work.
